newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sing Investments in share placement.
newsitem.headline: Sing Investments in share placement.

text.p: Sing Investments and Finance Ltd said on Monday it entered into an agreement with Overseas Chinese Banking Corp Ltd for the private placement of 4.54 million shares.
Sing Investments said in a statement OCBC Bank, as the manager of the private placement, would subscribe or procure the subscription of the shares at a value of Singapore $1.00 each.
The proceeds from the placement, conditional on approval by the Stock Exchange of Singapore, would be used as working capital for the group, it said.
